name: helical-spring
why: A helical pipe against the tube formula: a 2 mm wire on a radius-10, pitch-5, three-turn helix is pi * 1^2 * 3 * sqrt((20 pi)^2 + 25) = 594.048 mm3, area 1194.380 mm2. The exact B-rep reads 594.0481 and 1194.3795 through BRepGProp (a STEP round trip through probe_step_export); the volume recorded here is the mesh's, 0.55% under, which is a 1 mm tube's facets at 0.01 mm deflection and not the solid. The spine is a B-spline fitted to a line on a cylinder's parameter space, measured within 1e-8 mm of the exact helix; a spine past 1e-4 mm is refused. The implicit half is the contract: refuse by name, never approximate.
